claims.statement: Complete setup reports permit source acceptance despite unavailable or failed build and test capabilities.
Environment operations receive at most two automatic attempts, with a 30-second delay before the second.
The resident limits each environment attempt to 30 minutes.
Project image checks inspect container archives without executing image programs.
The deletion broker stops Project containers before deleting Project records.
The Setup Journal shows one latest-state row per milestone while retaining operation messages from earlier attempts.
The Setup Journal requires initial acceptance and a ready environment for completion, and ends initial history at the first successful acceptance.
The setup directive requires an ordered checklist from prerequisite discovery through image assessment and post-decision verification.
The shared environment skill requires dependency availability in fresh containers and classification of unresolved results and missing prerequisites.
Image proposals require credible feasibility evidence, a material development benefit, and an assessment of remaining prerequisites and image costs.
Image additions cannot supply host access, macOS interfaces, or extra container privileges, and a Docker client alone supplies no daemon.
After prerequisite assessment, setup permits completion with unavailable commands when no permitted image proposal provides a credible material benefit.
An initial continuation requires completion after approval or denial, and expected capabilities remain unverified until the assigned image executes affected commands.
Initial setup completion can change the setup script without image approval, while image inputs must match the assigned configuration.
Setup and pipeline agents share limits of 4 GiB memory, two processors, and 512 processes.
Project containers share a persistent home while separate temporary .agents, .claude, and .codex mounts isolate their role files.
Automatic cache eviction preserves .lock files and reports an error if remaining bytes exceed the limit; manual removal clears all cache entries.
The environment lane measures and reports Project home bytes separately from disposable cache bytes.
The shared environment skill assigns automatic setup preparation to Worker, Verifier, and Packager runs and exempts Scribe, Strategist, and Arbiter runs.
Setup history requires a setup identifier and either completed initial setup or a selected environment revision.
The browser smoke checks history access through Environment, return to Environment, and the normal Board after reload.
The current setup failure's Ask Collie action appears with the setup controls outside the transcript.
The setup journal smoke checks Ask Collie beside Retry and the absence of action controls inside the transcript.
Project selections include the last recorded runtime check, with empty fields when no check exists.
The resident reuses a successful runtime check only when the recorded image digest and runtime identity match the current selection and release.
Reuse of a recorded runtime check still verifies local image availability and records a failure if the selected image is missing.
Initial environment acceptance sets installation-wide Discord availability in the transaction that marks the Project ready.
The shared environment skill requires agents to preserve supplied credential configuration and exclude credential values from output.
Workspace preview directs an existing file path to its containing Project folder and requires an accessible parent for an absent folder.
The active queued or running setup and validation operation receives provider access before its first heartbeat, with a deadline 30 minutes after creation.
The published update keeps the image and base digests that each Project selects.
A recorded runtime check does not skip the optional OpenCode compatibility check when its volume exists; the selected image must execute the OpenCode program.
Public updates check selected Project images, including archived Projects, and preserve them across runtime replacement.
Update reconciliation records interrupted environment operations as failed after writers stop and supplies an Environment-page retry action.
The Worker uses a proposal and checkpoint for a prerequisite that Image dependencies can supply; the Verifier returns CORRECT for that cause.
Unavailable checks remain unverified, and the exception for host checks outside criteria excludes new or changed tests.
